notes.title: Changelog 1.2.0
notes.notes:
[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Add a "New" hint for the first met item to the devil's offers
[*] Add items Sum of cards for each playing card suit
[*] Add new upgrade available hint
[*] Add prop overview
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Unable to load "Only show available items" setting
[*] Unable to use Wheat seed if it didn't use at the beginning of the round
[/list]
[h3]Refactorings[/h3]
[list]
[*] Merge poker related items into item Poker for better control
[*] Disable dice and poker related items since there are better version exist
[*] Scale payback based on the game round
[/list]

notes.title: Changelog 1.1.0
notes.notes:
[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hide unavailable items (and add a dedicated toggle in the setting)
[*] Show project version
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Missing simplified Chinese fonts
[*] Unable to scroll prop result
[/list]
[h3]Refactorings[/h3]
[list]
[*] Make Wheat seed grow automatically (since players are very likely to click every round)
[*] Separate setting save file and game save file (your setting will reset due to this refactoring)
[/list]
